description: Generate month-end checklist: unconfirmed journals/invoices, unreconciled bank transactions, and overdue receivables/payables. Overdue = due date before overdue_as_of (the month's last day, or today while the month is still open; invoices falling due from today up to and including month-end are listed separately under due_before_month_end_*).

fresh.description: Clear cached API/reference data before running the checklist (use after web UI changes).
